capability.summary: Download the complete current song as stereo 24-bit 44.1 kHz WAV or 320 kbps MP3 through one public API and GUI. Capture the full arrangement and mix before asynchronous work, reuse every built-in DSP processor in an independent offline graph, and preserve live playback. Explicit user feature instruction authorizes product implementation despite the default GA-only scope.

controls.description: Toolbar dialog chooses WAV or MP3, reports progress, cancels without downloading, and permits retry after failure.
controls.test: Chrome GUI downloads real files, checks format headers, retries an injected encoder failure, cancels graph initialization, and verifies live playback remains running.

fixtures: Stereo phrase-order and gain fixture decoded from WAV and MP3
All five built-in effects and repeat-bounce comparisons
Captured ADSR, engine settings, mutes, melody octaves, harmony and vocal timing
GUI download, cancellation, error retry and playback isolation
Built production preview with real WAV and MP3 downloads
Manual full NEON SAUVAGE - Library song exports in the running local GUI
